Payment is requested within 30 days of the invoice date (19 November 2026), with installment payment possible by arrangement.
data.explanation: This is an invoice from your hearing aid acoustician for the part of your new hearing aids that your health insurance did not cover. The total you owe is €1,400.00, due within 30 days of the invoice date shown. The app will show you the exact deadline. If you cannot pay the full amount at once, the letter says installment payment (Ratenzahlung) can be arranged with them directly. Since this concerns a medical aid, keep this invoice for your tax return, as such costs may be deductible. If anything in the amount seems wrong, contact the acoustician using the details on the invoice before the payment is due.
data.tax_note: Out-of-pocket costs for medically necessary hearing aids can usually be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in your income tax return; keep this invoice as proof.
